patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Lusha and Ocean.io share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Lusha only if your buying job matches “B2B data intelligence platform for verified contact/company data, enrichment, signals, and” rather than Ocean.io's shape. Choose Ocean.io only if your buying job matches “Lookalike / similar-company prospecting with credit waterfall enrichment — from ~$0.063/cr” rather than Lusha's shape. Workflow advantage: Lusha leans contact-management; Ocean.io leans data-enrichment, lead-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Lusha and Ocean.io share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Lusha is B2B data intelligence platform for verified contact/company data, enrichment, signals, and Engage outreach sequences.; Ocean.io is Lookalike / similar-company prospecting with credit waterfall enrichment — from ~$0.063/credit, ~$47/mo yearly headline..
- Workflow coverage skew: Lusha-leaning contact-management vs Ocean.io-leaning data-enrichment, lead-management.
- Researched limits: Lusha — Not a full CRM pipeline/deal system — buyers still need a CRM of record for pipeline hygiene.; Ocean.io — Lookalike/similar-company specialist — not a full contact mega-database or sequencer.

Limitations — Lusha: Not a full CRM pipeline/deal system — buyers still need a CRM of record for pipeline hygiene.; Credit-based consumption for reveals/signals/API; unused annual credits do not roll over.; Ocean.io: Lookalike/similar-company specialist — not a full contact mega-database or sequencer; Credit minimums and yearly packaging require modeling before comparing to seat tools.

Poor-fit cases: Lusha is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a full CRM pipeline/deal system — buyers still need a CRM of record for pipeline hygiene. · Ocean.io is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Lookalike/similar-company specialist — not a full contact mega-database or sequencer · Avoid Lusha if you actually need Ocean.io's motion (Lookalike / similar-company prospecting with credit waterfall enrichment — from )

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
